domain: energy markets / wholesale electricity spot prices
prediction_question: For a New Zealand pricing region (island-level aggregate of published nodal final prices), will the daily mean final wholesale energy price on a trading day about a week ahead exceed a threshold fixed from the training window?
prediction_time: The publication instant of final prices: the Electricity Authority states interim prices 'will be declared to be final prices by 2pm the following business day' (Real-time dispatch and pricing page + Code Part 13); measured on the actual files, Last-Modified minus trade date is p50 1.80 days, max 5.80 days (368 daily files, measured 2026-10-22). Features are final prices for trading dates already published at the instant; the label day is not.
target_definition: Binary: market/island daily mean of DollarsPerMegawattHour over all trading periods of day D+k exceeds a threshold frozen from the training window (candidate fixed thresholds measured at 100/150/200/300 $/MWh; a per-region training-quantile threshold is the alternative). Label source columns: the target day's per-POC prices, excluded from shipped features.

license_evidence: EMI Legal information (https://www.emi.ea.govt.nz/LegalInformation, read 2026-10-22): 'Unless indicated otherwise for specific items or collections of content (either below or within specific items or collections), this copyright material is licensed for re-use under the Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) 4.0 international licence. In essence, you are free to copy, store, distribute and adapt the material, as long as you attribute it to the Electricity Authority... and abide by the other licence terms.' Restricted material carve-outs are emblems/trademarks, EMI tools and models, third-party works and section-46 request responses - the FinalEnergyPrices CSV datasets are Authority content and none of the carve-outs.

Successor hub copyright statement (https://www.ea.govt.nz/copyright-disclaimer-transparency/, read 2026-10-22): 'Unless indicated otherwise for specific items or collections of content (either below or within specific items or collections), this copyright material is licensed for re-use under the Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) 4.0 international licence... Copyright material on this website is protected by copyright owned by the Electricity Authority on behalf of the Crown.' - the same licence posture carries across the EMI retirement onto the Data & insights hub.

EMI retirement is announced ('The Electricity Authority will soon begin to decommission the EMI platform... A new Data & insights hub... will replace EMI', read on https://www.emi.ea.govt.nz/ 2026-10-22): a source-migration risk, not a licence risk - the same datasets are already catalogued on the hub at https://www.ea.govt.nz/data-and-insights/datasets/wholesale/dispatch-and-pricing/ and the licence statement covers both. Construction must pin exact URLs and record digests.
split_strategy: Temporal windows on the 1996-10..2026-10 daily panel, e.g. train 1996-10..2015-12 / eval 2016-01..2020-12 / holdout 2021-01..2026-10; each window contains at least one measured high-price episode (train: 2008-07 measured 9/31 days >$200; eval: 2020-06 measured 5/30 days >$200 with mid-month means to $287; holdout: 2024-08 measured 25/31 days >$200). Positives cluster into multi-day weather/storage episodes, so split capacity is counted per episode-week, not per day; sampled episode weeks measured, exact counts computed at construction over the full files. The 2022-11-01 real-time-pricing regime change (ex-post -> real-time pricing, documented by the publisher) is a structural break: either bound all windows inside one regime or ship a regime indicator; decided and documented at construction.

measurements.era_and_event_samples_measured: market daily-mean $/MWh (mean over POCs x periods): 1997-01 min 26 / median 42 / max 50, 0 days >$100; 2008-07 median 135 / max 306, 13 days >$150, 9 >$200; 2020-06 median 145 / max 287, 12 days >$150 (mid-month event); 2024-08 median 436 / max 884, 27 days >$150, 25 >$200, 22 >$300; recent era (12 sampled days 2025-10..2026-10) median 32 / max 165, 1 day >$100
measurements.known_event_fixtures: August 2024 dry-year price episode: measured daily means 2024-08-05..08-08 of 815-884 $/MWh - must exceed any training-frozen threshold; 2008 winter dry-year: 2008-07-01 mean 306 - must exceed $200; quiet-era control: 1997-01 max 50 - must not exceed $100. Fixtures to be pinned from the publisher's own market commentary at construction.
measurements.extraction_cost_measured: probe: 19 requests, 45,112,531 bytes, 75.1 s (4 whole monthly files + 12 daily files + mapping + listings) on this coordinator; full construction estimated (not measured) at 728 files / 3,714.3 MB / ~1-2 h sequential on a worker - labelled an estimate from the measured per-file sizes
measurements.measured_on: 2026-10-22 via .factory/nz_ea_probe.py (v1, listing crashed on the monthly-file name shape, diagnosed), .factory/nz_listing_stats.py, .factory/nz_ea_probe2.py; commands and outputs in notes.md

review: Class A licence read first-hand on both the current platform and its announced successor; 30 years of daily-grain labels; a documented publication instant with measured file lags; publisher-published regional mapping; strong clustered event structure (dry-year episodes) and quiet eras giving both classes in every candidate window. Prior art is level-regression forecasting (EPF benchmark, an AUT study, a single-node GitHub project) - no published exceedance task with splits and a scored contract.
next_action: Construction on the worker: (1) enumerate the 728 files via the container listing, download all monthly+daily price files (or stream and aggregate), join POC->Island/Network-reporting-region via the NSP table with point-in-time POC validity; (2) build the daily region x day panel; (3) define the D+k exceedance label with a threshold frozen on the training window (fixed $/MWh or training quantile - decide and document, with the measured 100/150/200/300 rates as the decision basis); (4) decide and document the 2022-11-01 regime-break treatment; (5) baseline triad (persistence: last-published day/week mean above threshold; calendar-only; model) before any headroom claim; (6) pin known-event fixtures (Aug 2024, Jul 2008, quiet-era control) from the publisher's own commentary; (7) qualification gate per the dataset-qualification skill. Pin exact blob URLs + digests because EMI is being decommissioned onto the Data & insights hub.
